features.description: Activity gains tags/subject/level; facets INHERITED at read time from cited materials; list filters + /facets endpoint mirroring 1.1.58 semantics
acceptance_criteria: An activity citing a Fysik document matches ?subject=Fysik with NO activity-level subject set
Re-tagging the cited document changes what the activity matches, with zero writes to the activity
Shared catalogue (published=true) inherits only from ownerScope=='shared' docs — a private upload's tags never leak
Tag filter is AND across multiple tags and case-insensitive
__unlevelled__ returns activities with neither own nor inherited level
A deleted cited doc contributes nothing and does not error the list
/facets counts are narrowed per-facet: picking a subject re-counts tags, sibling subjects keep their counts
total is the full match count, not the page length
ActivityUpsert still rejects unknown fields (extra=forbid)
make lint && make test-fast green with no regression from the 2667 baseline
features.notes: GET /api/activities response shape changes from a bare list to {activities,total,limit,offset} — seed-guide-corpus.mjs reads it as a list and is NOT covered by CI.

features.description: Extract shared FacetRow; search + facet chips + pagination on the activities library and the cross-teacher shared catalogue; per-activity facet editor with visibly-inherited chips
acceptance_criteria: Tagging a document in Materials makes the citing activity findable under that tag with no activity edit
Existing MaterialsSection tests pass UNCHANGED after the FacetRow extraction
elementPayload() carries tags/subject/level so saving from the builder cannot wipe facets set elsewhere, with a test asserting it
Inherited chips render visibly distinct (dimmed + paperclip) and are not removable
Subject options come from GET /facets, not a hardcoded frontend array
Search is debounced (no fetch per keystroke)
Empty / loading / no-match states render
npm run quality:check green with no regression from the 1500 baseline
features.notes: The FacetRow extraction must be behaviour-neutral for Materials; treat any diff in its existing tests as a regression, not an expected update.

features.description: Authoring co-pilot can search materials by tag/subject/folder and file the activity it authored; aiplatform CLI mirrors the web filter contract
acceptance_criteria: attach_material passes tags/subject/folder through to the curriculum browse
A set_activity_facets proposal round-trips through applyCopilotProposal (propose-only, nothing applies without Apply)
aiplatform activity list supports --tag/--subject/--level/-q and activity set writes them
Backend and frontend quality gates stay green
features.notes: Lowest priority — M1+M2 deliver the user-visible goal on their own.
